Where every fixture in this directory came from
===============================================

Nothing here was invented.  Each report is a real artifact one of the two
sibling AION layout tools produced from a real container run, trimmed only
where a file was too large to read.

clean/
    The verified-clean run of the worked example, copied verbatim from
    tools/aion_layout_claude/build/ on 2026-09-05.

    drc/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.magic.drc/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.magic.drc.rpt
        Magic, "[INFO] COUNT: 0".  Ground truth: clean=True, reported_count=0.
    drc/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.klayout.drc/*_full.lyrdb
        KLayout, zero <item>.  TRIMMED: the original declares 560 empty rule
        categories (113 kB); only the first 4 are kept.  The merge reports the
        categories that carry an item, and there are none, so the trim cannot
        change any graded value.  Ground truth: clean=True, 0 violations.
    drc/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.klayout.drc/klayout.receipt.json
        Regenerated by verification.write_klayout_receipt() over the trimmed
        directory so the receipt names the file that is actually there.
        exit_status 0.  Ground truth: completeness == "verified".
    lvs/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.magic.lvs/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.lvs.out
        Netgen, "Final result: Circuits match uniquely."  Ground truth:
        clean=True, verdict "match_uniquely", 8|8 devices, 9|9 nets.

dirty/
    A real failing iteration of the same cell, copied verbatim from
    tools/aion_layout_kimi/tests/fixtures/iteration_0/.  It is here because a
    suite that only ever sees clean artifacts can pass while detecting nothing:
    these pin that a violation that IS there is found.

    drc/.../AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.magic.drc.rpt
        Magic, "[INFO] COUNT: 8" over two latch-up sections.  Ground truth:
        clean=False, 8 violations, categories LU.a and LU.b.
    drc/.../AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1_AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1_latchup.lyrdb
        KLayout, one LU.b item as a polygon <values> string.  Ground truth:
        clean=False, 1 violation, category "LU.b".
    drc/.../klayout.receipt.json
        Regenerated by write_klayout_receipt() with exit_status 1 (the runner's
        "ran to completion, found violations" status).  Ground truth:
        completeness == "verified" AND clean == False -- the report is refused
        for its items, not for its extent.
    lvs/.../AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.lvs.out
        Netgen, "Final result: Top level cell failed pin matching."  Ground
        truth: clean=False, verdict "failed_pin_matching", unmatched pin rows.

gds/
    AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.gds
        The built, DRC- and LVS-clean worked example, copied byte for byte from
        build/AION_inv_nand2_nor2_1.gds (md5 d71274adad959db790812748a8bc7cec).
        It lives here rather than being read out of build/ because build/ is
        .gitignore'd: reading the ground truth from a scratch tree made fifteen
        tests skip silently on any checkout that had not run `make` yet.
        Ground truth, re-measured 2026-09-05 against the live container:
          prBoundary 189/4 = 0..2.88 x 0..3.78 um, area 10.8864 um2, 6 sites;
          Metal1 (8/0) present with 18 polygons, no Metal2 (10/0) at all;
          Magic DRC "[INFO] COUNT: 0"; KLayout 0 items, completeness verified;
          Netgen "Circuits match uniquely", 4|4 nmos, 4|4 pmos, 9|9 nets.

liberty/
    Hand written, not captured: no characterisation run exists yet.  The two
    files are a minimal but syntactically real Liberty pair whose numbers were
    chosen to make interpolation checkable by hand; see the comments inside.
